chemicals.name: DEHT
chemicals.of: 22 foods in the second round of sampling
chemicals.detail: Median 2,510 µg/kg in the foods measured for it (n = 19). Median in burritos 6,000 µg/kg. Median in hamburgers 2,200 µg/kg. Not detected in fries.

chemicals.name: DnBP
chemicals.detail: Detected in every hamburger in the study. A phthalate that U.S. rules have limited in some products.

chemicals.name: DEHP
chemicals.detail: Detected in every hamburger in the study. Median in hamburgers 36.0 µg/kg.

chemicals.name: DEHA
chemicals.detail: Median 45.7 µg/kg in burritos and 6.7 µg/kg in hamburgers.

chemicals.name: DEP
chemicals.detail: Detected in 39 percent of the foods.

chemicals.name: DiBP
chemicals.detail: Measured only in the first round of sampling.

chemicals.name: DiNP
chemicals.detail: Median 36 µg/kg in burritos and 5.9 µg/kg in cheese pizza.

chemicals.name: BBzP
chemicals.detail: Detected in 20 percent of the foods.

chemicals.name: DINCH
chemicals.detail: Median 7.1 µg/kg in five hamburgers. Also found in one pair of handling gloves.

chemicals.name: DnOP
chemicals.detail: Detected in 6 percent of the foods.

chemicals.name: DMP
chemicals.detail: Not detected in any food sample.
